verdicts.evidence: Derivation audit identifies H(t)^(N-1) as the sole N-dependent term giving exponential contraction; numerical audit with 500K datasets per N∈{2,4,8,16,32,64} shows bias contracting from +0.574 to +0.0016 with all intervals inside analytic bounds; destructive control removing independent censoring makes the upper bound fail by >10x.

Derivation audit confirms ADD-specific reduction to Eq. (9) bounds via Stute substitutions; numerical audit with 500K datasets per N''∈{2..64} (event rate 0.5, censoring rate 0.3, b=5) shows all bias±5SE intervals inside integrated bounds; shared destructive control confirms independent censoring is load-bearing.

GSR detector on Gaussian stream with N=1000, 9 non-degenerate ARL configurations × 10 seeds: |KM bias| < |LB bias| in all 9 configurations, 10/10 seeds each (e.g., KM -0.175 vs LB -0.522 at heaviest censoring); ADD side shows KM-ADD beats LB-ADD in 29/30 seed-runs.

Both directions of the support condition tested with 10 seeds per N∈{50,200,1000,5000,20000}: bias converges from -0.023 to +0.003 (sd shrinking 2.65→0.46) when support satisfied (T=5000), but plateaus at -0.107 and does not vanish when support violated (T=100).
The logbook explicitly states the WISDM real-data variance claim was not attempted; no experiments or data from the WISDM Actitracker dataset were run.

Gaussian sweep covers prevalence 0.1–0.9 with KM-ARL relative bias -0.014 to -0.028 (within ±5%) across fixed and irregular lengths; Poisson repair (λ_pre=1, λ_post=4, 14 GSR thresholds, N=10K, both length regimes) shows KM beats LB on curve error in 95.0% of 60 seed-cells with median ratio 0.567, and 1.001 in the null zone.

overall: The logbook provides concrete numerical evidence supporting five of six claims through proof audits, 500K-dataset finite-sample bound checks, and multi-seed simulations on both Gaussian and Poisson changepoint models with destructive controls. The WISDM real-data variance claim (Claim 5) is explicitly not attempted, leaving it inconclusive.
